@section l35-01 | Unit 1 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 1 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ken a______ed his objective by working hard and following other people's advice.
= achieved
~詞義 achieve（v.）達成
~原文 Ken achieved his objective by working hard and following other people's advice.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Our school basketball team has p______med especially well this season. We have now won five games in a row.
= performed
~詞義 perform（v.）表現
~原文 Our school basketball team has performed especially well this season. We have now won five games in a row.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After serving a three-year sentence, the man was r______ed from prison last month.
= released
~詞義 release（v.）釋放
~原文 After serving a three-year sentence, the man was released from prison last month.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After weeks of careful preparation, the students were ______ (anxiety) to start the experiment.
= anxious
~詞義 anxious（adj.）急切渴望的
~原文 After weeks of careful preparation, the students were anxious to start the experiment.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The cute design of this product is ______ (appeal) to many teenage girls.
= appealing
~詞義 appealing（adj.）有吸引力的
~原文 The cute design of this product is appealing to many teenage girls.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: An official from the Ministry of Agriculture warned that the price of most vegetables was going to ______ by around 10% owing to the strong typhoon.
A: increase
B: transform
C: explore
D: unite
= A
~詞義 increase（v.）增加
~原文 An official from the Ministry of Agriculture warned that the price of most vegetables was going to increase by around 10% owing to the strong typhoon.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Credit cards are not really bad as long as people can ______ to pay their bills every month.
A: decrease
B: enable
C: reform
D: afford
= D
~詞義 afford（v.）負擔得起
~原文 Credit cards are not really bad as long as people can afford to pay their bills every month.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ lasted more than five hours, but, fortunately, the doctors said it was a complete success.
A: pollution
B: operation
C: condition
D: majority
= B
~詞義 operation（n.）手術
~原文 The operation lasted more than five hours, but, fortunately, the doctors said it was a complete success.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tim was very fortunate to be selected from more than 200 applicants. His work experience and positive ______ made him stand out from others.
A: product
B: situation
C: tendency
D: attitude
= D
~詞義 attitude（n.）態度
~原文 Tim was very fortunate to be selected from more than 200 applicants. His work experience and positive attitude made him stand out from others.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Before we jump to ______, let's gather more evidence to understand what really happened.
A: varieties
B: passages
C: reactions
D: conclusions
= D
~詞義 conclusion（n.）結論
~原文 Before we jump to conclusions, let's gather more evidence to understand what really happened.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: inform
B: background
C: original
D: enables
E: produce
F: emotional

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The government's new policy was made during a(n) ______ of rising unemployment.
= B
~詞義 background（n.）背景
~原文 The government's new policy was made during a(n) background of rising unemployment.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The test ______ a pregnant woman to find out the sex of her baby before it's born.
= D
~詞義 enable（v.）使能夠
~原文 The test enables a pregnant woman to find out the sex of her baby before it's born.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Buying fresh ______ directly from farmers not only supports local agriculture but also costs less than shopping at the market.
= E
~詞義 produce（n.）農產品
~原文 Buying fresh produce directly from farmers not only supports local agriculture but also costs less than shopping at the market.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: There are several ways to deal with sexual harassment in the workplace. One is for victims to ______ their supervisors.
= A
~詞義 inform（v.）通知
~原文 There are several ways to deal with sexual harassment in the workplace. One is for victims to inform their supervisors.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The definition of many English words today are quite different from their ______ meaning.
= C
~詞義 original（adj.）最初的
~原文 The definition of many English words today are quite different from their original meaning.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: information
B: reacted
C: polluted
D: probable
E: unity
F: familiar

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The voice on the phone sounded ______, but Amanda couldn't remember where she'd heard it.
= F
~詞義 familiar（adj.）熟悉的
~原文 The voice on the phone sounded familiar, but Amanda couldn't remember where she'd heard it.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The rivers in the area are heavily ______ with harmful chemicals from both agriculture and the manufacturing industry.
= C
~詞義 pollute（adj.）污染
~原文 The rivers in the area are heavily polluted with harmful chemicals from both agriculture and the manufacturing industry.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The prime minister ______ angrily to the rumor because it was going to damage his reputation and leave a bad impression of him on the public.
= B
~詞義 react（v.）反應
~原文 The prime minister reacted angrily to the rumor because it was going to damage his reputation and leave a bad impression of him on the public.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: This company tends to hire people from a variety of backgrounds. Therefore, it's not easy to make all the employees work together in ______.
= E
~詞義 unity（n.）團結
~原文 This company tends to hire people from a variety of backgrounds. Therefore, it's not easy to make all the employees work together in unity.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before students use sources from the Internet, they must check whether the ______ is accurate and reliable.
= A
~詞義 information（n.）資訊
~原文 Before students use sources from the Internet, they must check whether the information is accurate and reliable.
